name: Realm of Kings
description: In the aftermath of the War of Kings, a massive tear in spacetime—the Fault—opens into a nightmarish alternate universe. The Inhumans must guard the rift while cosmic horrors seep through the wound between realities.
flavorText: The Fault is open. What comes through is not of this universe.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Wonder / Awe Discovery. Spacetime Fault opening with cosmic horrors. Vast unstable orchestral swells. Cosmic and nightmarish, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
